global_style: Create one production-ready stylized PBR game asset for a Roblox collectible arena. Use a deliberate, recognizable silhouette, layered solid geometry, crisp bevels, readable color blocks, and detailed craftsmanship comparable to an ornate gold Millennium Puzzle. Make details readable at normal third-person camera distance. Use clean UVs and an efficient atlas. Keep the object isolated, centered, and complete on every visible side.

mesh_pipeline.preferred_format: GLB with textures; FBX with separate texture images if GLB import fails.
mesh_pipeline.mesh_coordinates: Map final imports to Roblox +Y up and -Z forward. Do not assume raw exporter axes already match.
mesh_pipeline.material_policy: Use a small material count and efficient atlases. Keep alpha blending off unless demonstrably required.
mesh_pipeline.roblox_pbr: Map approved PBR textures through SurfaceAppearance. Confirm MetalnessMap and RoughnessMap channels after import.
mesh_pipeline.triangle_budgets: Per assembled asset targets, not per submesh. Actual output must be inspected and decimated if needed.
mesh_pipeline.budget_policy: Prefer silhouette and large physical detail over tiny hidden geometry. Use normal maps for small grooves. Large scenery gets up to 18,000 triangles.
mesh_pipeline.text_policy: Use SurfaceGui, BillboardGui, decals, or approved image assets for text, card symbols, screens, and exact artwork. Do not depend on generated lettering.
mesh_pipeline.animation_policy: Static Meshy output is not automatically a working bird rig. Keep Ho-Oh body, wings, and tail separate, fit pivots in Blender or Studio, and build a real Roblox animation assembly.
mesh_pipeline.security_policy: No API credentials belong in this manifest, prompts, game files, or source control.
mesh_pipeline.prompt_policy: Each prompt is a complete Meshy-ready brief of at most 600 characters. Full art direction remains in design_brief. negative_prompt is metadata only; do not send it as an unsupported API field.

gameplay_outside_mesh_generation: Catalog IDs and balanced stats, rarity weights, sword/axe/pickaxe spawn reductions, conveyor speed, ownership, death persistence, purchases, theft, and collection are game-code changes.
The eight power definitions, cooldowns, server validation, shield hit handling, and attack particles/trails are game-code and Roblox VFX work.
The Infinity Stone level reward and comet celebration need once-only server-controlled logic and a legitimate client event.
HUD size, label size, card text overlays, rainbows, and clearing old white-ball scenery are Roblox layout/integration changes.
The Meshy prompts do not imply any of those systems are implemented.
